assumptions.assumption: Invoices with no non-missing price are skipped entirely, so the average line-item count is over the same set of invoices as the average of means.
Only invoices that have at least one row in Invoice_Line_Items are considered; invoices with zero line items are not counted.
The line-item count counts all line-item rows on an invoice, including those with a missing price.

alternatives.interpretation: The skipping applies only to the mean price. The average line-item count is taken over all invoices that have line items, including those whose prices are all missing.

assumptions.assumption: The average line-item count is taken over every invoice that has at least one line item. This includes invoices where all prices are missing, since only the price mean skips those invoices. Every row in Invoice_Line_Items counts as a line item.
Invoices with no rows in Invoice_Line_Items are left out of both averages.

alternatives.interpretation: The line-item average covers only the invoices that have a mean price. Invoices with no non-missing price are dropped from both values.
